demo.title: Demo card
demo.notice: This is a demo card. Nothing you do here changes your real cards.

cells.cook: Cook a new recipe every month

steps.overview: Your New Year's resolutions are spread across a bingo card: complete them to mark their cells, and fill a whole row, column or diagonal to score a bingo!
steps.card: This is your card. It mixes your own resolutions with your team's goals, and the joker in the centre is a free cell.
steps.cell: Each cell holds one resolution. Tap this cell to open its details.
steps.detail: The details show the resolution, its current state and what you can do with it.
steps.complete: Achieved it? Tap Mark Complete to try it.
steps.completed: The cell gets a stamp. Your teammates see it and can ask you for proof.
